title: Marguerite and the Bell
author: Ines Amberdale
blurb: Rosalind Blackwood, a folklorist recording songs the village refuses to sing twice, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. Then the sleep recordings capture a second voice answering questions — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must get the family out ahead of the count, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
